headline: Result Update

highlights: Treasury booked a ₹12.8bn loss (Q1FY27: ₹28.8bn gain); ex the one- off, we estimate ~₹117.8bn. • Expense Management: Opex rose 9.6% YoY and 15.6% QoQ to ₹339.8bn.

Cost-to-income rose to 49.82% (Q1FY27: 46.71%), and would be ~55.8% ex the one-off gain, by our estimate. • Core Profitability: Operating profit rose 7.3% YoY to ₹342.3bn; PAT of ₹230.4bn takes H1FY27 PAT to ₹441.6bn (+12.3% YoY).
Ex-FCNR(B) (~US$10.9bn), management put deposit growth at ~10.5%. • CASA Trends: Domestic CASA grew 8.1% YoY; the CASA ratio eased to 38.32% (Q2FY26: 39.63%).

Savings deposits grew 8.8% and retail term deposits 16.7% YoY. • Liquidity: Excess G-secs of over ₹4 lakh crs above SLR; domestic CD ratio 73.02% and LCR 140.47% give headroom for the 14-15% FY27 credit-growth guidance. • Capital: CRAR strengthened to 16.09% (Q2FY26: 14.62%) with CET-1 at 13.34%.
watch: Retail term deposits are ~61.7% of domestic deposits. • Margin Outlook: Management reiterated FY27 domestic NIM of 3% or above (H1FY27: 3.06%), citing EBLR/MCLR resets and lower deposit costs; RoA ~1% and RoE ~15% guidance retained. • Credit Growth: Advances grew 17.8% YoY to ₹52.08 lakh crs, led by Agri (+22.6%), SME (+22.0%) and Corporate (+16.1%).

Management is monitoring ~₹100bn of agri exposure in three drought-affected states. • Provisions: Loan-loss provisions fell 33.2% YoY to ₹27.6bn (credit cost 0.22%) on lower stress formation and ~₹32bn of recoveries; ECL impact ~₹195bn post-tax. • Non-interest income: Treasury booked a ₹12.8bn loss on the move in bond yields.
